name: PostgreSQL
certifications: AWS Certified Database - Specialty (retired; content still useful for RDS and Aurora)

beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and junior DBAs new to PostgreSQL. Covers installing and connecting, databases and schemas, data types, constraints, writing and querying data, joins, aggregation, CTEs, views, indexes, transactions, roles and privileges, functions in SQL and PL/pgSQL, JSONB, dates and time zones, loading data with COPY, backups with pg_dump and connecting from application code.
prerequisites: Knows what tables, rows and columns are
outcomes: Install PostgreSQL and work confidently in psql and pgAdmin
Design tables with correct types and constraints
Write queries with joins, aggregates, CTEs and JSONB
Secure access with roles, take backups and connect from an application

subtopics: What PostgreSQL is and where it is used
Open source licence and release cycle
Client-server architecture: postmaster and backend processes
Installing on Linux, Windows and with Docker
The data directory and main configuration files
Starting, stopping and checking the server
days.lab_task: Install PostgreSQL with Docker and natively, connect with psql and pgAdmin, load the course sample database and find the data directory, version and running processes.
days.deliverable: Install notes, connection screenshots and a short description of the processes found

subtopics: ALTER TABLE: add, rename and drop columns
days.lab_task: Create a library database with app and reporting schemas, create books, members and loans tables with identity keys, then alter them as requirements change and add comments.
days.deliverable: DDL script and schema description
checks: Unqualified name resolves to the expected schema

subtopics: Integer, numeric and floating point types
Choosing types for storage and correctness
days.lab_task: Store prices as numeric and float, compare rounding results, store events as timestamp and timestamptz across time zones, and add a UUID column and an array of tags to books.
days.deliverable: Script with results and a type choice note
checks: Sum 0.1 ten times in float and numeric
Float shows rounding error and numeric does not
Read a timestamptz in two time zones
Same instant shown in local times
Array containment returns the right books
objectives: Avoid rounding and time zone errors

subtopics: Foreign keys and ON DELETE actions
days.lab_task: Add primary keys, foreign keys with sensible delete rules, a unique email, a check that loan return dates follow loan dates and an exclusion constraint that stops a room being double-booked.
days.deliverable: Constraint script and test results
checks: Return a book before it was borrowed

days.lab_task: Load members, update overdue loans with a join, upsert a book feed with ON CONFLICT, delete expired members with USING and return changed rows each time.
days.deliverable: DML script and output
checks: Run an UPDATE inside BEGIN and ROLLBACK

days.topic: Querying: Filtering, Sorting and Pattern Matching
subtopics: ORDER BY with NULLS FIRST and LAST
days.lab_task: Answer ten questions about the library, including case-insensitive title search, latest loan per member with DISTINCT ON and labelling members by activity with CASE.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: Rows without dates at the end

days.lab_task: Report loans with member and book details, list books never borrowed with NOT EXISTS, fill in missing dates with generate_series and get the top three loans per member with LATERAL.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: Every day present, including days with no loans
Up to three loans per member

subtopics: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX
Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK and running totals
days.lab_task: Build monthly loan statistics with FILTER for overdue loans, subtotals with ROLLUP, running totals and month-over-month change with windows, and median loan length.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: Overdue and total counts in one query
Subtotals and grand total rows present
Value from percentile_cont matches a manual check

days.lab_task: Write a report as a chain of CTEs, walk a category hierarchy with a recursive CTE and archive old loans in one statement with a data-modifying CTE.
days.deliverable: Query file and results
checks: Each CTE does one named step

days.lab_task: Create a view of active loans, make an updatable view with CHECK OPTION, build a materialised view of monthly statistics and refresh it concurrently while it is being queried.
days.deliverable: View definitions and test results
checks: Insert through the view outside its condition

days.lab_task: Load a million loans, time three slow queries, read their plans, add the right indexes and show the plans and times afterwards.
days.deliverable: Before and after plans and timings

subtopics: Row locks and SELECT FOR UPDATE
days.lab_task: Run two psql sessions to see uncommitted changes stay invisible, use a savepoint to recover from an error, reserve a book with SELECT FOR UPDATE and create and read a deadlock error.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and notes
checks: Read from session two before commit
One transaction aborted with a deadlock error

days.lab_task: Create an application role with read-write access to the app schema, a read-only reporting role, default privileges for new tables and a pg_hba.conf rule allowing only SCRAM logins from the app subnet.
days.deliverable: Role script, pg_hba.conf extract and access tests
checks: Create a new table and read it as reporting
Log in with the wrong method

days.topic: Functions and Procedures in SQL and PL/pgSQL
subtopics: PL/pgSQL blocks, declarations and control flow
Security definer functions and their risks
days.lab_task: Write a function that calculates fines, a set-returning function for a member's history and a procedure that closes a month's loans with error handling.
days.deliverable: Function and procedure code and tests
checks: Call the fine function for three cases
Call the procedure with bad data
Error caught and a clear message raised

subtopics: Problems caused by too many triggers
days.lab_task: Add a trigger that sets updated_at, an audit trigger that stores old and new rows as JSONB for loans and a check that blocks deleting members with open loans.
days.deliverable: Trigger code and audit table output
checks: updated_at changes and an audit row is written
Delete a member with open loans
Old and new values both stored

subtopics: When to use columns instead of JSON
days.lab_task: Store book metadata from an API as JSONB, query nested fields, update a value, build JSON responses with jsonb_agg and index containment queries with GIN.
days.deliverable: Queries, index and timing results

days.topic: Loading and Exporting Data with COPY
subtopics: CSV options: headers, delimiters and quotes
Loading from programs with COPY FROM PROGRAM
days.lab_task: Load a 500,000-row CSV with \copy into a staging table, clean and move it into the main table, export a report to CSV and compare load time with row-by-row inserts.
days.deliverable: Load script, export file and timing comparison
checks: Load a file with a bad row
Bad row found and handled in staging

subtopics: pg_dump formats: plain, custom and directory
days.lab_task: Back up the library database in custom format, restore it into a new database, restore a single table after an accidental delete and back up roles with pg_dumpall.
days.deliverable: Backup files, restore commands and verification queries
checks: Restore roles on a fresh server

days.lab_task: Write a small Python service that lists and borrows books with parameterised queries, a connection pool and a transaction, then show why string-built SQL is unsafe.
days.deliverable: Application code and a SQL injection demonstration
checks: Parameterised query treats it as data

days.lab_task: Design and build a library database with constraints, indexes, views, functions, audit triggers and roles, write ten reports, connect a small application, back it up and restore it on a new server.
days.deliverable: DDL and DML scripts, reports, application code and restore evidence
checks: Correct results within one second each
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one database

intermediate.summary: For developers and DBAs who use PostgreSQL daily. Covers configuration, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index types, query tuning, statistics, MVCC and vacuum, locking, isolation levels, partitioning, full-text search, extensions, physical and logical replication, point-in-time recovery with pgBackRest, monitoring, PgBouncer, security, safe schema migrations, foreign data wrappers and managed cloud PostgreSQL.
prerequisites: Writes SQL with joins, CTEs and window functions
Has created tables, indexes and roles in PostgreSQL
Comfortable on the Linux command line
outcomes: Tune queries and configuration using plans and statistics
Keep databases healthy with vacuum, monitoring and pooling
Set up replication and point-in-time recovery
Change schemas safely and run PostgreSQL on cloud services

days.lab_task: Size memory settings for a 16 GB server, change a reloadable and a restart-only setting, turn on slow-query and lock-wait logging and confirm the values in pg_settings.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes, reasons and pg_settings output
checks: Change work_mem with ALTER SYSTEM and reload

subtopics: Plan nodes: scans, joins and sorts
Sorts and hashes spilling to disk
days.lab_task: Read the plans of five slow queries, find the most expensive node in each, spot a bad row estimate and a sort that spills to disk and explain what each plan is doing.
days.deliverable: Annotated plans
checks: External merge shown in the plan

days.topic: Index Types: B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN and Hash
subtopics: Index-only scans and the visibility map
days.lab_task: Add a partial index for open orders, an expression index for lower(email), a covering index for an index-only scan, a BRIN index on a 50-million-row log table and compare sizes and speeds.
days.deliverable: Index scripts, plans and a size and speed table
checks: Create an index CONCURRENTLY under load

subtopics: Pagination with keyset instead of OFFSET
days.lab_task: Take the top five queries from pg_stat_statements, tune each by rewriting or indexing, replace OFFSET pagination with keyset pagination and record before and after times.
days.deliverable: Tuning log with plans and timings
checks: Keyset page fast and OFFSET page slow
Total time for the queries reduced

days.lab_task: Create a table with two correlated columns, show a bad estimate, fix it with extended statistics, raise a column's statistics target and compare plans.
days.deliverable: Plans before and after and pg_stats output
checks: Estimate far below actual before the fix
Most common values shown for the column

subtopics: Row versions and xmin and xmax
days.lab_task: Generate dead tuples with heavy updates, watch autovacuum clean them, block cleanup with a long open transaction, tune autovacuum for a hot table and check wraparound age.
days.deliverable: Monitoring queries, settings and observations
checks: Hold a transaction open during updates
Dead tuples not removed until it ends

days.lab_task: Create a lock queue with an ALTER TABLE behind a long query, find the blocker, use lock_timeout to protect the migration and build a job queue with SKIP LOCKED.
days.deliverable: Lock queries, session transcripts and the job queue code
checks: Fails fast instead of blocking others

subtopics: Anomalies: lost updates, write skew and phantoms
days.lab_task: Show a lost update in read committed, fix it with SELECT FOR UPDATE and with repeatable read, show write skew and fix it with serializable plus a retry loop.
days.deliverable: Session transcripts and retry code
checks: One transaction fails with a serialisation error

subtopics: Indexes and keys on partitioned tables
When partitioning helps and when it does not
days.lab_task: Partition an events table by month, show pruning in plans, automate future partitions with pg_partman and archive an old month by detaching it.
days.deliverable: Partition scripts, plans and archive steps

subtopics: When to use a separate search engine
days.lab_task: Add search to a product catalogue with a weighted generated tsvector, rank and highlight results, support typos with pg_trgm and index both.
days.deliverable: Search queries, indexes and sample results

days.lab_task: Enable pg_stat_statements and report the top queries by total time, store store locations with PostGIS and find the nearest five stores, and use citext for case-insensitive emails.
days.deliverable: Extension list, queries and results
checks: Five closest stores in distance order
Insert an email differing only in case

days.lab_task: Build a primary and a standby with pg_basebackup and a replication slot, run read queries on the standby, measure lag under load and promote the standby after stopping the primary.
days.deliverable: Configuration, lag measurements and failover steps
checks: Lag reported in bytes and seconds

subtopics: Restoring to a point in time
days.lab_task: Configure pgBackRest with WAL archiving, take full and incremental backups, drop a table by mistake and restore the database to one minute before the drop.
days.deliverable: pgBackRest configuration, backup list and recovery evidence
checks: Restore time recorded against the target
objectives: Recover to a point in time

subtopics: Statistics views: pg_stat_activity, pg_stat_database and others
days.lab_task: Set up postgres_exporter with Prometheus and a Grafana dashboard, find idle-in-transaction sessions and unused indexes, and add alerts for replication lag and connection use.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, monitoring queries and alert rules
checks: Leave a session idle in transaction

subtopics: PgBouncer modes: session, transaction and statement
Pooling in the application versus a proxy
Running PgBouncer next to the database or the app
days.lab_task: Put PgBouncer in transaction mode in front of the database, run pgbench with 500 clients with and without it, and fix an application that breaks because it relies on session state.
days.deliverable: PgBouncer configuration and benchmark results

subtopics: Security checks with a hardening checklist
days.lab_task: Require TLS for all remote connections, add row-level security so each tenant sees only their rows, log access to a sensitive table with pgAudit and review the server against a hardening checklist.
days.deliverable: TLS configuration, policies, audit log and checklist

subtopics: Migration tools: Flyway, Liquibase and Sqitch
Adding NOT NULL and foreign keys without long locks
days.lab_task: Run a migration that adds a non-null foreign key to a 20-million-row table under load using NOT VALID constraints, a concurrent index and a batched backfill, with no blocked writes.
days.deliverable: Migration scripts and load test results
checks: No write errors or long waits

days.topic: Logical Replication and Change Data Capture
subtopics: Conflicts and how to fix them
days.lab_task: Replicate two tables to a reporting database with a row filter, cause and fix a conflict and stream changes to Kafka with Debezium.
days.deliverable: Publication and subscription setup, conflict notes and Kafka output
checks: Conflict found in the logs and fixed

days.topic: Managed PostgreSQL: RDS, Aurora, Azure and Cloud SQL
subtopics: What managed services handle for you
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Backups, replicas and high availability options
days.lab_task: Create a PostgreSQL instance on two cloud providers, change a parameter, create a read replica, restore to a point in time and compare features, limits and monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Instance settings, test results and comparison table
checks: Restore to a point in time
New instance with data from that time
Blocked and the managed alternative used
Monthly cost for the same size on both

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Tuning and Protecting a Production-Like Database
days.lab_task: Take over a slow, unprotected order database: tune its top queries and configuration, add pooling, a standby, point-in-time recovery, monitoring and row-level security, run a safe migration under load and present the results.
days.deliverable: Tuning log, configuration, recovery test, dashboard and presentation
checks: Each top query faster after tuning
Point-in-time recovery succeeds within the target
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one database

advanced.summary: For senior DBAs, platform engineers and architects. Covers storage and WAL internals, high availability with Patroni, tuning heavy workloads, checkpoints and WAL, bloat management, major upgrades without downtime, sharding with Citus, PostgreSQL on Kubernetes, disaster recovery, compliance, multi-tenant design, time series, pgvector, Oracle migration, observability at scale, capacity planning, automation, production troubleshooting and running a database platform.
prerequisites: Has set up replication and backups
Tunes queries with EXPLAIN and pg_stat_statements
outcomes: Run highly available PostgreSQL with automatic failover
Tune and scale heavy workloads and upgrade without downtime
Design multi-tenant, sharded and AI workloads
Diagnose production incidents and run PostgreSQL as a platform

days.topic: PostgreSQL Internals: Storage, Pages and WAL
subtopics: The visibility map and free space map
days.lab_task: Inspect a table page with pageinspect, read WAL records for an update with pg_waldump, show a HOT update after lowering fillfactor and see which tables fill shared buffers.
days.deliverable: Annotated internals notes
checks: Read the WAL record for an update

subtopics: HAProxy or virtual IPs for routing
days.lab_task: Build a three-node Patroni cluster with etcd and HAProxy, kill the leader under load, measure failover time and run a planned switchover.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, failover timings and runbook
checks: New leader elected and writes resume

subtopics: WAL compression and full page writes
Operating system and file system settings
days.lab_task: Benchmark a write-heavy workload, tune checkpoints, WAL and memory, test synchronous_commit off for one table's workload, and report throughput and latency for each change.
days.deliverable: Benchmark report with each change and its effect
checks: Throughput gain and data loss risk stated
Each change justified by a measurement

subtopics: Preventing bloat with autovacuum and design
days.lab_task: Measure bloat on a busy table and its indexes, rebuild indexes concurrently, repack the table online with pg_repack under load and change settings to stop bloat returning.
days.deliverable: Bloat measurements before and after and the maintenance plan
checks: Percentage reported for the table and indexes

days.lab_task: Upgrade a database from PostgreSQL 13 to 17 twice: with pg_upgrade in link mode and with logical replication, measure downtime for each and write a rollback plan.
days.deliverable: Upgrade runbooks, downtime measurements and rollback plan

days.topic: Scaling Out with Citus and Sharding
subtopics: When one server is not enough
Alternatives: read replicas, partitioning and application sharding
days.lab_task: Shard a multi-tenant SaaS schema with Citus by tenant, co-locate related tables, rebalance after adding a worker and compare query times with a single node.
days.deliverable: Distribution design, rebalancing evidence and benchmark
checks: Shards moved and queries keep working

days.lab_task: Deploy a three-instance CloudNativePG cluster with backups to object storage, delete the primary pod under load, restore a cluster from backup and run a rolling minor upgrade.
days.deliverable: Cluster manifests, failover and restore evidence
objectives: Back up and restore on Kubernetes

days.lab_task: Add a cross-region standby and a one-hour delayed replica, copy backups to a second region, run a DR drill that fails over to the other region and recover an accidental delete from the delayed replica.
days.deliverable: DR plan, drill report and runbook
checks: Service restored in the other region within the target
Rows recovered from the delayed replica

subtopics: Audit requirements for PCI DSS and SOC 2
Masking and anonymising data for test environments
days.lab_task: Review a server against the CIS PostgreSQL Benchmark, fix the failures, build a masked copy of production for testing and prepare audit evidence for access to card data.
days.deliverable: Benchmark results, fixes, masked database and audit evidence pack
checks: Access to card data traceable to people

subtopics: Shared tables, schema per tenant and database per tenant
days.lab_task: Build the same SaaS app with shared tables and RLS and with schema per tenant, migrate 500 tenant schemas, restore a single tenant and compare operational effort.
days.deliverable: Two designs, migration timings and comparison
checks: Only that tenant's data returned under RLS
All migrated with the time recorded

days.lab_task: Store a month of sensor data in a hypertable, compress older chunks, build continuous aggregates for dashboards, add a retention policy and compare with a plain partitioned table.
days.deliverable: Schema, compression results and dashboard
checks: Storage reduced by at least 80 percent

days.topic: Vector Search and AI Workloads with pgvector
subtopics: Hybrid search with full-text and vectors
tools: OpenAI or a local embedding model
days.lab_task: Store embeddings for 100,000 documents, compare exact search with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes for recall and speed, add metadata filters and combine with full-text ranking.
days.deliverable: Schema, benchmark of recall and latency and hybrid query
checks: Results combine text and vector scores

days.topic: Foreign Data Wrappers and Cross-Database Queries
days.lab_task: Query a second PostgreSQL database through postgres_fdw, check that filters are pushed down, join with local tables and read a CSV file as a table.
days.deliverable: FDW setup, queries and plans
checks: Rows returned from the remote database
Remote SQL includes the WHERE clause

days.lab_task: Assess a sample Oracle schema with ora2pg, convert tables, a package and a trigger, migrate data, validate row counts and checksums and write the cutover plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment report, converted code, validation and cutover plan
checks: Effort estimate and problem objects listed

days.lab_task: Build fleet dashboards for ten databases, enable auto_explain for slow queries, analyse a day of logs with pgBadger and define SLOs and alerts for the database service.
days.deliverable: Dashboards, pgBadger report and SLO definitions
checks: Top slow queries and lock waits reported

subtopics: Cost of instance sizes and storage
days.lab_task: Forecast storage and CPU for the next 18 months from metrics, decide when to scale, plan archiving of old data and estimate cost savings.
days.deliverable: Capacity forecast, scaling plan and cost estimate
checks: Based on at least three months of data

days.lab_task: Write an Ansible role that installs and configures PostgreSQL with pgBackRest and monitoring, provision a managed instance with Terraform and run an automated weekly restore test.
days.deliverable: Ansible role, Terraform code and restore test pipeline
checks: Run the role on a fresh server
Server configured with no manual steps

subtopics: Sudden slow queries after plan changes
days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix five injected incidents (a plan regression, a lock pile-up, a full disk from a stuck replication slot, a connection storm and lag from a long query on a standby) and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: WAL space freed and the cause removed
Blocker found and the queue cleared

days.topic: Running PostgreSQL as a Database Platform
subtopics: Guardrails and reviews for schema changes
days.lab_task: Design a PostgreSQL platform service for 30 application teams: standard builds, service levels, an onboarding guide, schema review rules and a 12-month roadmap.
days.deliverable: Platform design, onboarding guide and roadmap
checks: Availability, recovery and support times defined
A team can get a database without asking the DBA team
Priorities linked to platform health measures

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Highly Available PostgreSQL Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build a production PostgreSQL platform for a payments service: Patroni HA, cross-region DR, PgBouncer, tuned configuration, partitioning or sharding, security hardening, automation and a game day with failover, restore and an upgrade.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, automation code, game day report and review presentation
checks: Run the failover in the game day
Upgrade completed within the downtime budget
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
